ok  	github.com/janearc/slayer/manufacture	0.219s

Only prototype constructs these private needle surfaces in production.
Its public key domain is styles 1/2, bins 0..4, variants 0/1.
The producer exhausts all twenty plans: 29322 needles, 58644 closed
surfaces. Every tested signed six-volume is strictly positive; minimum
4.5009001857683491e-10. Both open clump surfaces return before this code.

The producer checks the root of the first two faces and all vertices of
the first face as volume origins. The returned surface may already have
its winding reversed. Reversing the last two vertices of every triangle
negates its triple product; checking both first-face side vertices covers
the origin selection on either side of that reversal. The alternative
origins therefore have the same nonzero sign before the reversal too.
Only the sign controls output; no computed volume is stored.

To reproduce, copy needle_volume_domain_sample_test.go into manufacture,
run go test -count=1 -v -run
'^TestDiagnosticNeedleVolumeSignsAcrossThePrototypeDomain$' ./manufacture,
then remove the temporary copy. Review the finite domain again if its
caller, key domain or embedded parameters change. This establishes three
isolated operation equivalences, not botanical or experimental validity.
